_comment: B-play self-play mix (docs/tactician-bc-campaign.md step 12b): the validation set for C2 and the regeneration channel for C4. Same sampling as mix.json (per-game, seeded; held-out pool.json pairings always excluded) but the Strategist searches - searchBudget benchmark (1-2s/activation, UctOptions.Benchmark) with searchWorkers 4, the exact bot the B-gate measured. Half the games pit the search against the A-play Tactician it wraps, half are a search mirror. Run at --dop 6 (6 games x 4 root workers = 24 threads) into its own dated directory; never alongside another self-play process. Data, not code - edit and relaunch without a rebuild.
